sentence: A 2024 audit of the regional supply chain identified 14 critical vulnerabilities across three distribution hubs, with the highest concentration in cold storage facilities operating below the mandated 34-degree Fahrenheit threshold. The audit estimated that unaddressed vulnerabilities would increase spoilage losses by approximately 23 percent annually, at a projected cost of $4.2 million to the consortium.
